mapper.select: select count(*) from SYS_Participant_Unit mn left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join Sys_Company c1 on c1.C_Id=mn.C_Id where 1=1

select pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Name_History as pNameHistory, c1.C_Name as cName, c1.C_Code as cCode, c1.C_Name_History as cNameHistory, c1.C_Creditcode as cCreditcode, mn.* from SYS_Participant_Unit mn left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join Sys_Company c1 on c1.C_Id=mn.C_Id where mn.P_Id=#{pId} order by mn.Pu_Create_Time DESC
